decision: Keep the already running original full-data v/shared/Xavier model. Retain fan-in as an explicit alternative, without restarting on a small inconclusive short-budget gain.
rationale: Primary point estimates increase, but both paired intervals include0. PDCorr/PDS changes are inconclusive; pseudobulk MSE and MAE worsen and DEPrec falls.
